tagline.en: The Pacific shore road between the Coastal Range and the sea, a Qing footpath completed as a motor road with American aid in 1968
tagline.zh: 夹在海岸山脉与太平洋之间的海岸公路，由清代步道起步，1968 年在美援下全线通车

start.en: Nanpu, Ji'an, just south of Hualien city, on Provincial Highway 9
start.zh: 花莲县吉安乡南埔，花莲市南侧，衔接台 9 线

end.en: Huangye (Dongkeng), at the northern edge of Taimali, Taitung, on Provincial Highway 9
end.zh: 台东县太麻里乡北端荒野（洞坑），衔接台 9 线

en: Provincial Highway 11 runs down the east coast from Hualien to beyond Taitung, on the narrow shelf between the Coastal Range and the Pacific. It is the 'sea line' of the east, as bus companies called it, against the 'mountain line', Highway 9, in the Huadong Rift Valley behind the range. It leaves Highway 9 at Ji'an, crosses the mouth of the Hualien River and follows the shore through Shoufeng, Fengbin, Changbin, Chenggong and Donghe to Taitung city and back to Highway 9 north of Taimali.

The towns are small and the strip of flat land thin. Most of the villages along it are Amis, with some Kavalan and Puyuma. Much of the coast lies in the East Coast National Scenic Area — Shitiping, the Baxian caves, Sanxiantai, Shiyusan — and the road is known as a scenic drive more than a through route. Its highest point is the saddle of Beijialulan Mountain at the 30 km mark, on the old road above the Baqi tunnel.
zh: 台 11 线沿东海岸自花莲南下，越过台东市，行于海岸山脉与太平洋之间狭窄的海岸台地上。客运公司称它为“海线”，与山脉另一侧花东纵谷中的“山线”台 9 线相对。它在吉安自台 9 线分出，跨过花莲溪口，沿海经寿丰、丰滨、长滨、成功、东河至台东市，在太麻里北端接回台 9 线。
沿线城镇规模不大，平地狭长。两侧多为阿美族部落，另有部分噶玛兰族与卑南族。大段海岸属于东部海岸国家风景区——石梯坪、八仙洞、三仙台、石雨伞——这条路更以景观公路著称，而非过境干道。全线最高点在 30 公里处、芭崎隧道上方旧路的北加路兰山鞍部。

en: In 1877 the Fujian governor Ding Richang and the Taiwan garrison commander Wu Guangliang opened a road down the southern coast and settled more than 2,000 people from Shantou there. Wu's footpath ran from Dagangkou at the mouth of the Xiuguluan River by Nana (Zhangyuan), Kakawasan (Changbin) and Chengguang'ao (Chenggong) towards Taitung, and was finished in 1878. North of Dagangkou the coast to Hualien had only footpaths.

The Japanese rebuilt the southern road as the Taitung–Mataian road, widening it from 1917; between 1921 and 1926 the Taitung–Xingang stretch became a 5.45 m motor road with 48 bridges. The road from Taitung to Jingpu was finished in 1930, and later pieces from Jingpu to Fengbin and from Fengbin over the Coastal Range to Mataian in the rift valley, today's Highway 11A. With no bridge over the Xiuguluan, buses went only as far as Jingpu.

The missing link was built in the 1960s. In March 1965 the government began a programme of new eastern industrial roads, six roads and three bridges, one of them the Hualien coast road from the Hualien River to Jingpu by Shuilian, Fengbin and Dagangkou. The roughly 50 km from Hualien by Shuilian and Jiqi to Fengbin was made a motor road for the first time, and the Changhong bridge was built over the Xiuguluan. The road opened on 28 June 1968 with the vice-president, Yen Chia-kan, and the defence minister, Chiang Ching-kuo, at the ceremony. It was numbered Highway 11 in 1975, and the old route over the range to Guangfu became Highway 11A.

From 1990 the Six-Year National Development Plan recast the road from a means of opening up the east to one for the economy and tourism, and widening followed. It was contested: in 1996 a Hualien resident wrote to the press, the Min Sheng Bao ran a week of coverage, and campaigners questioned whether a road widened by cutting into the range on one side and filling the shore on the other, then armoured with tetrapods, would leave the coast worth visiting.
zh: 1877 年（光绪三年），福建巡抚丁日昌与台湾镇总兵吴光亮开辟沿南段海岸的道路，并招汕头潮民二千余人在此屯垦。吴光亮所辟的人行道路自秀姑峦溪口的大港口起，经纳纳社（樟原）、加走湾（长滨）、成广澳（成功）通往台东，1878 年竣工。大港口以北至花莲的海岸，只有步道。
日治时期依循旧路修筑为“台东—马太鞍道”，1917 年起拓宽；1921 至 1926 年间，台东至新港段拓宽为 5.45 米宽的汽车道，架设桥梁 48 处。1930 年完成台东至静浦段，其后又完成静浦至猫公（丰滨）、以及自丰滨翻越海岸山脉至纵谷马太鞍的路段（今台 11 甲线）。因秀姑峦溪未架桥，公路班车只开到静浦。

缺口在 1960 年代补上。1965 年 3 月起，政府办理“东部产业道路新辟工程”，共新辟道路 6 条、新建桥梁 3 座，其中一条是自花莲溪经水琏、丰滨、大港口至静浦的花莲海岸路。花莲经水琏、矶崎至丰滨约 50 公里，首度修成车道，秀姑峦溪上新建长虹桥。1968 年 6 月 28 日举行通车典礼，副总统严家淦、国防部长蒋经国等出席。1975 年正式编为台 11 线，翻越海岸山脉至光复的旧线则改为台 11 甲线。
1990 年起，行政院国家建设六年计划使台 11 线的角色由开发东部资源转为“提振经济与发展观光”，拓宽随之而来，却引起争议：1996 年，花莲在地人黄雍熙投书媒体，《民生报》一连七天大篇幅报导；反对者质疑，一边向海岸山脉借地、一边填海，再堆满消波块的道路，是否还会让人想来东海岸。

en: The first Changhong bridge, built from June 1967 to May 1968, is 120 m long with a clear width of 7.5 m; it was Taiwan's first prestressed-concrete bridge built by the balanced-cantilever method, with a gravel deck when it opened. It is now a footbridge. Its replacement downstream, begun in 1998 as part of the widening and opened on 20 January 2003, is a single-span 185 m steel tied arch, 21.7 m wide and painted orange-red, with a cycle lane and eight viewing balconies over the river where the rafting trips finish.

Further south, the Mawuku River at Donghe shows three generations of bridge. The Yoshida bridge, a steel-cable suspension bridge rebuilt in 1926 after a storm, was named after the Japanese engineer of the Taitung district office who designed it and died before it was finished. Its cables corroded, and by 1952 heavy vehicles were banned and bus passengers had to walk across; in 1953 it was rebuilt as a concrete bridge, a T-beam on the soft south bank and an open-spandrel arch on the limestone north bank, keeping the old central tower. In 1992 a steel bridge was built downstream and the old one became a footbridge.

The northern section is the fragile one. The Coastal Range north of Fengbin is weak rock, and typhoon landslides used to cut it often; a Shuilian resident recalled that the village was left 'like an island', with the only way out over the range and across the Hualien River on foot.
zh: 第一代长虹桥 1967 年 6 月动工，1968 年 5 月完工，长 120 米、净宽 7.5 米，是台湾第一座悬臂延伸式预力混凝土桥，通车时桥面还铺石子路，现改为人行步道。下游的第二代桥于 1998 年配合台 11 线拓宽动工，2003 年 1 月 20 日通车，主桥为单跨 185 米的中承式系索钢拱桥，宽 21.7 米，漆成橙红色，设有自行车道与八座俯瞰泛舟终点的观景台。

再往南，东河的马武窟溪上可见三代桥梁。吉田桥为钢索吊桥，1925 年遭暴风雨吹坏后于 1926 年重建，由台东厅技师吉田一之设计，他在桥成之前病逝，桥遂以其姓命名。战后钢索锈蚀，1952 年起禁止重车通行，公路局班车乘客须下车步行过桥；1953 年改建为混凝土桥——南岸地质松软，用 T 型梁，北岸为坚硬石灰岩，用开腹式拱桥——并保留了原有的中央桥塔。1992 年在下游另建钢桥，旧桥改为行人景观桥。
北段最为脆弱。丰滨以北的海岸山脉地质脆弱，过去一遇台风常因山崩而断路；一位水琏居民回忆，坍方时村子“跟孤岛一样”，只能翻过海岸山脉、涉水渡过花莲溪出入。

en: No cost has been published for the coast road as a whole, or for the 1965–1968 programme. The figures that exist are for its bridges. The first Changhong bridge cost NT$8.53 million in 1968, of which NT$6.12 million was an American aid grant and NT$2.41 million came from the Taiwan provincial government. At Donghe, the Japanese rebuilt the Yoshida bridge in 1926 for 48,000 yen, and the 1953 concrete bridge cost NT$1.04 million.
zh: 整条海岸公路以及 1965—1968 年的新辟工程都没有公开的造价，现有数字都属于桥梁。第一代长虹桥 1968 年新建经费新台币 853 万元，其中美援赠款 612 万元、台湾省政府款项 241 万元。东河的吉田桥 1926 年由日治当局以 4 万 8 千圆重建，1953 年改建混凝土桥的工程费为新台币 104 万元。

en: Limits are 25 to 70 km/h. It is a two-lane road for most of its length, with the sea close on one side; landslides north of Fengbin can still close it after typhoons. It is used as the scenic alternative to Highway 9, which runs through the more populated rift valley and remains the through road between Hualien and Taitung.
zh: 速限为每小时 25 至 70 公里。大部分路段为双车道，一侧紧临大海；台风过后，丰滨以北仍可能因坍方中断。它是台 9 线的景观替代路线；人口较多的纵谷里的台 9 线，仍是花莲至台东间的干道。

why.en: The road was built in pieces from 1877 to 1968 by the Qing, the Japanese and the provincial government, and widened from the 1990s; no cost for the whole road or for the 1965–1968 programme was found. Bridge costs are given below.
why.zh: 这条路自 1877 年至 1968 年由清廷、日治当局与省府分段修筑，1990 年代起再拓宽；未找到整条道路或 1965—1968 年工程的造价。桥梁造价列于下方。

value.en: NT$8.53 million (1968): US aid grant NT$6.12 million, Taiwan provincial government NT$2.41 million
value.zh: 新台币 853 万元（1968 年）：美援赠款 612 万元，台湾省政府 241 万元

figures.source: Ministry of Transportation and Communications, 交通年鑑 1968 (1969), p. 187, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 長虹橋 (花蓮)

value.en: 48,000 yen to rebuild the Yoshida suspension bridge (1926); NT$1.04 million for the concrete bridge (1953)
value.zh: 吉田吊桥重建 4 万 8 千圆（1926 年）；混凝土桥新台币 104 万元（1953 年）

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 舊東河橋, citing contemporary reports

value.en: The 1960s completion came under the eastern industrial roads programme in the American aid era; for the Changhong bridge, about 72% was a US aid grant and the rest provincial money. The sources do not give the split for the road itself.
value.zh: 1960 年代的全线贯通属美援时期的东部产业道路新辟工程；长虹桥约七成二为美援赠款，其余为省府款项。资料未说明道路本身的经费分摊。

figures.source: Rhythms Monthly, 後山後的慢板快奏 東海岸公路台十一線, by 鄭鼎民, Rhythms Monthly no. 106, May 2007; Chinese Wikipedia, 長虹橋 (花蓮)

timeline.en: Ding Richang and Wu Guangliang open a coast road and settle more than 2,000 people from Shantou.
timeline.zh: 丁日昌与吴光亮开辟海岸道路，并招汕头潮民二千余人屯垦。

timeline.en: The Taitung–Xingang road is widened for motor traffic; the Yoshida bridge at Donghe is rebuilt.
timeline.zh: 台东至新港段拓宽为汽车道；东河吉田桥重建完成。

timeline.en: The Japanese finish the coast road from Taitung to Jingpu.
timeline.zh: 日人完成台东至静浦段海岸公路。

timeline.en: The Donghe bridge is rebuilt in concrete.
timeline.zh: 东河桥改建为混凝土桥。

timeline.en: The eastern industrial roads programme begins in March.
timeline.zh: 3 月，东部产业道路新辟工程开工。

timeline.en: The Hualien–Fengbin road and the Changhong bridge open on 28 June, completing the coast road.
timeline.zh: 6 月 28 日，花莲至丰滨道路与长虹桥通车，海岸公路全线贯通。

timeline.en: The coast road is numbered Highway 11.
timeline.zh: 海岸公路编为台 11 线。

timeline.en: The Six-Year National Development Plan recasts the road for tourism; widening follows.
timeline.zh: 国家建设六年计划将台 11 线定位转向观光，其后展开拓宽。

timeline.en: A new steel bridge replaces the Donghe bridge.
timeline.zh: 新建钢桥取代东河旧桥。

timeline.en: The new Changhong bridge opens on 20 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 20 日，新长虹桥通车。
